correctness.rationale: The bird subsystem gives I_b*=mu_b(R0_b-1)/beta_b, so all-positive necessity and positivity of kappa coincide with R0_b>1. Substitution into the full human S/E/I/R equilibrium equations reduces to beta_h I_h^2+[kappa+mu_h(1-R0_h)]I_h -(mu_h R0_h/beta_h)kappa=0. Since beta_h>0 and constant term negative for kappa>0, one root is positive and one negative, and remaining compartments reconstruct positive. Expanding the exact positive root yields the three distinct kappa downarrow zero regimes. Independently checked rational constant terms for mu_h=2/5,beta_h=3/2,kappa=1/7,R0_h in {1/2,1,3/2}: -2/105,-4/105,-2/35. No stability conclusion asserted.
